status.summary: #2 featherweight and two-time title challenger. He lost unanimous decisions to Alexander Volkanovski for the vacant belt at UFC 314 (Apr 12, 2025; 49-46, 49-46, 48-47) and in the UFC 325 rematch (Jan 31, 2026; 49-46, 49-46, 50-45). Between those he stopped Jean Silva (Noche UFC, Sep 13, 2025, R2). He then rallied to knock out Steve Garcia with a counter left hook and follow-up punches at 2:42 of round 2 in the opening bout of UFC Freedom 250 on the White House lawn (Jun 14, 2026). Pro record 28-8 per ufcrankings.org (one results report says 29-8). Next he moves up to lightweight to challenge Charles Oliveira for the BMF title in the UFC 335 main event (Dec 12, 2026, Las Vegas).

style.summary: A Brazilian with a dangerous submission game who fights like a power striker: he trades in the pocket, throws spinning elbows and overhand rights, and takes hurt or tired strikers down to finish with ground strikes. His guard is dangerous. He is hittable and gives away early rounds, but he has never been knocked down in the UFC.

moves.notes: Weights sum to about 1 within each target group; spinning/knee/elbow are separate propensities. fighters.json career split of significant attempts: 81% head, 10% body, 10% legs; landed 72/12/16 (decayed 80/10/10 attempted). He is head-hunting, so most of the weight sits in the head group, spread across jab, right hand, left hook and overhand right, the punches behind his knockdowns of Volkanovski (jab plus overhand right) and Garcia (counter left hook). Body and leg kicks were a real part of the Volkanovski rematch (17 of 33 body, 20 of 27 leg), so body kick leads the body group; no source splits his low kicks by type, so calf/inside are 50/50. Spinning 0.10 and elbow 0.12 reflect the spinning back elbow that stopped Silva. Sources: ufcstats sums and per-fight rows in data/raw, CBS, Cageside Press.

appearance.build: tall and rangy for featherweight; 5 ft 11 in with a 72 in reach (ufcstats); moving up to 155 lb

engine_notes.note: Never knocked down in 10 UFC fights (okd 0) and no KO/TKO losses; all three UFC losses are decisions (Evloev, Volkanovski twice).
Power: 6 knockdowns in 117 UFC minutes; 4 of 7 UFC wins by KO/TKO.

In his 5-round fights his landed rate fell to 0.41 of round 1 by round 5 (pace 1, 1.01, 0.62, 0.91, 0.41); rounds 3-5 rest only on the two Volkanovski fights (pace_w 10 minutes each). Both title fights were won by Volkanovski in the late rounds, and the round-5 rows include being taken down in the rematch.
Ground strikes are 23% of his landed significant strikes (career), unusually high for a striker; he finishes hurt opponents on the mat.
